output.summary: KEP-5532 proposes a RestartAllContainers action on the KEP-5307 ContainerRestartRule API, so that a container exit matching a rule triggers an in-place restart of all pod containers (init, sidecar, regular) while preserving the sandbox, UID, IP, network namespace, and volumes. The KEP is currently implementable at stage beta.
output.rationale:
Restarting a whole pod today means deleting and recreating it, which is costly for workloads like AI/ML training and short-lived games; the KEP also covers sidecar failures that leave the main container with stale state. Reviewers pushed for a simple kill rather than graceful shutdown, and deferred volume cleanup/remount, leaving init containers required to be re-runnable. The status is implementable, beta, with SIG Node approval given on 2025-10-14.</rationale>
<parameter name="outcome_reason">null

alternatives.option: Graceful termination of all containers before restart
alternatives.why_not: Reviewers noted that a sidecar which de-registers the pod on graceful shutdown would break back-compat, so the KEP chose the 0 grace termination instead.

alternatives.option: Liveness probe on each container pointing at a sidecar, so a shutdown causes the pod to be killed
alternatives.why_not: Listed as an alternative in the discussion; the sources do not say why it was not adopted.

alternatives.option: Naming the action RestartAll or RestartContainers
alternatives.why_not: Reviewer asked whether these names were considered to avoid implying volumes are restarted; the KEP settled on RestartAllContainers, but the sources do not give a fuller rationale.

alternatives.option: Wiping and remounting volumes during the restart
alternatives.why_not: Deferred: SIG Node recommended deferring volume cleanup/re-mount and documenting the container contract clearly in beta.

evidence.quote: This "in-place" pod restart will terminate and then restart all of the pod's containers (including init and sidecar containers) while preserving the pod's sandbox, UID, network namespace, attached devices, and IP address.
this is resolved. We are going with the `0` grace termination. Please remove the unresolved thing
I strongly recommend deferring volume cleanup/re-mount and clearly documenting the new container contract. Keeping volumes as-is saves significant restart time
init containers have to be reentrant because kubelet never guarantees that it will not rerun them.
